name: Box
description: Resolves Box files and shared links through the official Box Content API.

account.secret_hint: The client secret of your own Box application, from the same page as the client ID above. Box requires it for every sign-in and for every renewal, so it stays stored; the access token the sign-in obtains is kept beside it and never over it.
account.username_hint: Box needs an application of your own — this project ships none, so that every installation has its own Box rate limit. In the Box Developer Console create a Custom App with User Authentication (OAuth 2.0), tick only the application scope "Read all files and folders stored in Box", add http://127.0.0.1:8710/api/v1/oauth/callback as a redirect URI, and paste the client ID here and the client secret below.

codes.box.download_not_permitted: Box does not serve this file to this account: it is restricted, locked, or shared without download permission
codes.box.file_not_found: This Box file does not exist, it is in the trash, or this account cannot see it
codes.box.is_a_folder: This Box address is a folder. Add it again to let the folder be listed
codes.box.link_access_denied: Box denied access to this shared link. If it is password-protected, add ?shared_link_password=… to the address; otherwise it was shared with somebody else
codes.box.not_a_box_link: This is not a Box file address
codes.box.not_a_file: This Box item is not a file and has nothing to download
codes.box.quota_exceeded: This Box account has used up its allowance
codes.box.rate_limited: Box is rate limiting this account. Its other links wait as long as Box asked
codes.box.sign_in_required: This Box account has to be signed in again
